question: Which monuments in Karnataka have been proposed for UNESCO’s World Heritage tentative list?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakkundi Monuments.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Karnataka's Lakkundi monuments, from the Kalyana Chalukya period, have been proposed for UNESCO’s World Heritage tentative list.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakkundi's key structures include the Kasi Visvesvara and Manikesvara temples, with stepwells integral to the temple complexes.**
 
• The monuments showcase a blend of architectural styles: Nagara, Dravida, and Bhumija, integrated into the Vesara style.
 
• This proposal reflects the historical and architectural significance of the monuments from the Kalyana Chalukya period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List__

 __
 
• The Tentative List is the first step in the process of nominating a site for inclusion in the World Heritage List, which recognizes cultural and natural heritage of outstanding value to humanity.
 
 
 
• Lakkundi Monuments__
 
 
• Lakkundi, a historic town in Karnataka, is known for its well-preserved Chalukyan architecture and ancient temples.
